projects.name: analog
projects.notes: Tests import workspace packages from node_modules/@analogjs, produced by the release build. libs/my-package runs in browser mode; packages/trpc has no tests.
projects.build: NX_NO_CLOUD=true pnpm exec nx run-many -t build --projects=tag:type:release --parallel=1

projects.name: CopilotKit
projects.notes: Tests import built workspace packages. The vue, angular and channels-core builds fail at the traced commit, but the outputs the tests need are produced, so build failures are tolerated. react-native is excluded (no web DOM).
projects.build: NX_NO_CLOUD=true pnpm exec nx run-many -t build -p @copilotkit/react-core @copilotkit/vue @copilotkit/angular @copilotkit/web-inspector @copilotkit/web-components @copilotkit/a2ui-renderer @copilotkit/mcp-apps-renderer --nxBail=false || true

projects.name: handsontable
projects.notes: Data grid; reported very slow under jsdom. Core unit tests mock the generated stylesheet because it makes jsdom's getComputedStyle ~10x slower per grid. E2E tests run in a real browser (Puppeteer) and are out of scope. Wrappers import the built core package (handsontable/tmp). The core suite needs BABEL_ENV=commonjs and the HOT_* constants that its scripts load from hot.config.js via env-cmd.

projects.name: ag-grid
projects.notes: Data grid; uses happy-dom for all unit and behavioural tests (Playwright only for benchmarks). testing/behavioural renders real grids (728 files). Tests resolve package sources through aliases, so no build step. Traced at release branch b36.2.0 (36.2.0 on npm): main depends on unpublished nightly ag-charts builds from AG Grid's internal registry and cannot be installed. b36.2.0 uses Yarn 1 and declares node ^22.21.1; installed with YARN_IGNORE_ENGINES=true (the env var also covers yarn calls in postinstall) on Node 22.17 (a patch-level difference; untraced baseline runs on the same Node).

projects.name: material-ui
projects.notes: React design system. Per-package vitest.config.mts with jsdom; *.browser.* tests run in Vitest browser mode via separate configs and are not traced. TZ=UTC as in the repo's test script.

projects.name: ariakit
projects.notes: React + Solid accessibility components on happy-dom (chosen by the project for speed). Root config with inline projects (extends: true); the node project is excluded.

projects.name: element-plus
projects.notes: Vue design system, jsdom. SSR tests use a separate config and are not traced.

projects.name: ngx-formly
projects.notes: Angular forms on Jest + happy-dom (@happy-dom/jest-environment), TypeScript Jest config. First Jest + happy-dom suite in the corpus.

projects.name: kobalte
projects.notes: Solid headless components, jsdom with isolate: false.

projects.name: radix-primitives
projects.notes: React headless components, jsdom. Root config with inline projects; only the jsdom 'unit' project is run (the 'rsc' project is node).

projects.name: react-hook-form
projects.notes: React forms, Jest + jest-fixed-jsdom. TEST_ENV=web selects the web project only, as in the repo's test:web script.

projects.name: vuetify
projects.notes: Vue design system. Config has a jsdom 'unit' project and a real-browser 'browser' project; only 'unit' is run. Declares node >=24.11.1 (not enforced; run on 22.23.3).

projects.name: svelte
projects.notes: Svelte runtime. Environment is set per file (// @vitest-environment jsdom); node-environment files are skipped by the tracer. Few test files drive thousands of samples, so per-file data is coarse.

projects.name: mantine
projects.notes: React design system, Jest + jsdom, TypeScript Jest config. Runs plain jest (the repo's test script also formats, lints and typechecks).

projects.name: react-spectrum
projects.notes: React design system and a11y primitives, Jest + jsdom. STRICT_MODE=1 VIRT_ON=1 as in the repo's test script. Its config sets projects: ['<rootDir>'], which the harness drops so the wrapper is used.

projects.name: nuxt-ui
projects.notes: Vue/Nuxt design system. Only the 'vue' project (happy-dom) is run; the 'nuxt' project uses the Nuxt test environment. Tests need the generated .nuxt/tsconfig.json, so the repo's dev:prepare script runs as the build step.

projects.name: ark-ui
projects.notes: Headless components for four frameworks from one codebase: React and Vue on happy-dom, Solid and Svelte on jsdom. bun monorepo (declares bun 1.4.2; installed with bun 1.4.2 via npx, because its lockfile format needs bun >= 1.4).

projects.name: emoji-picker-element
projects.notes: Vanilla custom element with shadow DOM, jsdom. The only jsdom-tested web component library found; most (lit, shoelace, FAST, ionic) test in real browsers.
